raw.cause: camera's handler wedged (camera-hang fault: after 5 frames camera_handle loops in pause() and never calls MsgReply), and this happened before the trace started. display calls MsgSend to camera synchronously from its only drawing thread, so thread 1 stays REPLY-blocked on camera forever and never reaches nav or logger again (0 completed messages, contract needs 3). A send timeout would not help: the name_attach channel has _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK, so a timed-out client stays blocked until the wedged camera handles the unblock pulse, which it never does.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (blocking call to camera from the main draw loop); MsgReply missing in camera
raw.fix_summary: Move the camera MsgSend out of the display loop into a dedicated reader thread. The loop draws the last frame that thread delivered and shows "camera stale" when the frame is old, so a hung or dead camera only blocks the reader thread. The reader thread also exits cleanly on error, so the display does not exit with a dead camera. This is the existing COCKPIT_FIXED path: make it the unconditional behaviour, or run with COCKPIT_FIXED=1. Separately, fix camera's frame grabber so it always replies, or use MsgError on failure.
